title: Kessler Care Essentials, Plus and Premium Replacement Purchases — Retail Plan Price and Contract Signing
content:
# Replacement Purchase of a Retail Kessler Care Plan

## Scope
The retail plan price of the Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans applies to a replacement purchase. A replacement purchase is a Kessler Care Essentials, Plus or Premium plan with all of these features:
- it is bought on its own;
- it is for the vehicle on the customer's single Kessler vehicle purchase deal that stands in delivered status (the vehicle being covered);
- it carries the same plan name as the replaced plan.

The **replaced plan** is the Essentials, Plus or Premium plan named on the customer's most recent signed cancellation request for a vehicle sold or traded, by request date. Where two such requests share that most recent date, or there is none, the purchase is not a replacement purchase. Any other retail plan bought on its own is outside this rule.

For a replacement purchase within this scope, and only for such a purchase, the retail plan price replaces its price. The following still hold:
- the plan is still offered only where it may be bought on its own;
- every other retail plan bought on its own is still priced at its retail plan price;
- a fleet addendum is outside this rule.

The pricing date is the day the plan is signed, and every plan figure used is that of the plan name bought.

## Fixing the retail plan price
The retail plan price is fixed only after every Kessler Care Essentials, Plus or Premium plan of the customer that carries a signed cancellation request for a vehicle sold or traded stands cancelled.

## How the plan is written
The plan is written for the store on the deal of the vehicle being covered, with no purchase deal attached, not financed and with no lienholder. It is dated the day it is signed. Its term ends at the sale date plus the plan's term months (calendar months) and at the odometer at signing plus the plan's term miles. The plan's included visits are loaded.

## Contract tool: `sign_care_plan_contract_c0d53aa0`
**Capability.** The individual customer signs a Kessler Care retail plan contract (Essentials, Plus or Premium) for a vehicle they own, buying the plan on its own: not on a vehicle purchase deal, not financed, with no lienholder. Signing opens a new active plan of the chosen name on that vehicle dated today, with a plan contract number, the term end date, the term end odometer and the price given, and loads the visits that plan includes.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `sign_care_plan_contract_c0d53aa0` and hands it over, and the customer themselves runs it.

**Parameters.**
- `customer_id`: Id. The reference number of the customer's profile that holds the new plan, as returned by the customer lookup.
- `vehicle_id`: Id. The reference number of the vehicle the plan covers, as returned by the vehicle lookup for this customer.
- `selling_store_id`: Id. The reference number of the store the plan is written for, as returned by the store lookup.
- `variant_name`: Enum. The plan bought, written as its official name. One of: Kessler Care Essentials 2-Visit, Kessler Care Essentials 4-Visit, Kessler Care Plus 6-Visit, Kessler Care Plus 8-Visit, Kessler Care Premium 10-Visit. Kessler Care Fleet 12-Visit is for fleet businesses only, so an individual customer's retail contract never takes it.
- `odometer_at_sale`: Fixed format. The vehicle's odometer reading at signing, in integer miles (whole miles, no separators).
- `expiration_date`: Fixed format. The last calendar day of the plan term, YYYY-MM-DD.
- `expiration_odometer`: Fixed format. The odometer reading at which the plan term ends, in integer miles.
- `purchase_price`: Fixed format. The price the customer pays for the plan, in US dollars to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent.

**Return.** A text receipt listing `maintenance_plan_id`, `plan_number`, `variant_name` (the plan name signed), `status` (active on success), `sale_date` (today), `expiration_date`, `expiration_odometer`, `purchase_price` (two decimals) and `visits_remaining` (visits loaded for that plan). The new plan then appears among the customer's maintenance plans.
